ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR38] GAP: requires Multi_Country__c (picklist) on moving into Solutioning/Negotiation/BV, per IRM correction (not the existing Multiple_Markets__c checkbox). Multi_Country__c does NOT exist yet - field must be created first;...
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) ),
ISPICKVAL(Multi_Country__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Multi-Country is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
